نتصاعد (form VI)
# نَتَصَاعَدُ (nataṣāʕadu) /na.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# نُتَصَاعَدُ (nutaṣāʕadu) /nu.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# نَتَصَاعَدَ (nataṣāʕada) /na.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# نُتَصَاعَدَ (nutaṣāʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
